title: Shakshuka
author: Layla Nasser
desc: Spiced tomato sauce with perfectly set eggs, feta, and fresh herbs. Weekend breakfast turned weeknight dinner.
steps: Sauté onion and pepper until soft. Add garlic and spices; cook 1 minute.
Pour in tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes until thickened. Season well.
Create 6 wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low until whites are set but yolks still runny (5–7 min).
Crumble feta over the top. Scatter fresh parsley. Serve from pan with crusty bread.
